## Proposed change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. List affected references, nets, and files.

## Evidence

Link manufacturer documentation and include relevant measurements or calculations. For an alternative part, specify the exact MPN, pinout, electrical limits, land pattern, height, temperature behavior, lifecycle evidence, and source.

## Design effects

Describe effects on power, independent recovery, return paths, impedance, clearance, assembly, enclosure fit, and cost where relevant.

## Verification plan

List the CAD, export, supplier-process, and first-article checks needed. Separate work already completed from proposed testing.
